lines: Issue bonds. Raise capital.
Bondrail brings revenue bonds to onchain businesses.
label: Revenue bonds for onchain businesses.

lines: A business can earn money every day and still need capital for its next move.
Bondrail lets it issue a bond, funded by investors and repaid from revenue.
label: A business is earning. Its next move needs capital.

lines: Take PumpLab, one of our testnet businesses.
Every trade builds a record investors can inspect. Revenue, payer concentration, even payments linked to the issuer.
Bondrail excludes those linked payments from the credit estimate.
label: Start with evidence.

lines: Investors funded PumpLab’s revenue bond with twenty USDC. Ten went to the business. Ten stays in escrow.
The next release needs a revenue milestone and a time window.
Capital moves in stages, with the repayment cap tied to what's actually released.
label: Fund the next move.

lines: Now, the moment that matters. A real test wallet makes a PumpLab trade on Monad.
A quarter of its trading fee goes straight to the bond, inside that same transaction.
Watch the repayment balance rise.
label: One trade. Automatic repayment.

lines: Here's the proof: the actual transfer to the bond.
No separate collection transaction.
label: Follow the money.

lines: For investors, the claim is tradable on Kuru.
Enter an amount. Check the quote. Buy.
The transaction confirms, and the claims arrive in the wallet.
Market price values future revenue. Cash backing is what's already been collected.
label: An investor has options.

lines: Or fund a business while it's still raising.
Here, one test USDC becomes one CurveLab claim.
The investor can withdraw while funding stays open. If the raise expires, cancellation makes refunds available.
label: Join the next raise.

lines: Bondrail also supports paid APIs.
Chainlink CRE simulation checks their payment destinations and broadcasts reports to Monad. Here's a real compliant report.
Checks run every thirty minutes. Two adjacent violation reports trigger default and stake slashing.
For these APIs, a separate transaction collects and splits the revenue.
label: Built for more than trading apps.

lines: Businesses issue bonds. Investors fund them. A share of revenue goes toward repayment.
Bondrail. Revenue bonds for onchain businesses.
label: Issue bonds. Raise capital.
